name: Test: rapid music box toggling (C#)
author: test
summary: Toggles the game's music box and the Example Mod one at 5 Hz and measures frame time, UpdateAudio time, threads and memory per phase.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csmusicbox. Run together with the Example Mod. Logs csmusicbox SEC per second, csmusicbox PHASE per phase, and csmusicbox END.
